entries.he: הַמִּתְפַּלֵּל בְּבֵית־הַכְּנֶסֶת, כְּאִלּוּ הֵבִיא מִנְחָה טְהוֹרָה.
entries.en: 2. One who prays in a synagogue, it is as if he brings a pure meal offering (mincha).

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 2
images.description: A joyful Na Nach father and three smiling boys with white knit caps and visible tzitzis walk through a flower garden on their way to communal prayer; the destination is outside the frame. Complete teaching caption below the scene.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 2
images.description: A joyful Na Nach father and three smiling boys with white knit caps and visible tzitzis walk through a flower garden on their way to communal prayer; the destination is outside the frame. Complete teaching caption below the scene.

entries.source_note: AI-generated editorial illustration of a joyful father and children on their way to communal prayer; the synagogue is outside the frame. The quoted teaching concerns prayer in a synagogue, not walking outdoors. איור שנוצר בבינה מלאכותית: אב וילדים שמחים בדרכם לתפילה בציבור; בית הכנסת מחוץ לתמונה. דברי המקור עוסקים בתפילה בבית הכנסת, ולא בהליכה בחוץ.

entries.en: 4. Due to adulation, one's prayer is not heard.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 4
images.description: A smiling bearded Na Nach father listens closely while one of three boys speaks respectfully in a shaded garden; closed unlettered books lie on the low table. Their ordinary white knitted tasselled caps are blank, and visible tzitzis hang from their garments.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 4
images.description: A smiling bearded Na Nach father listens closely while one of three boys speaks respectfully in a shaded garden; closed unlettered books lie on the low table. Their ordinary white knitted tasselled caps are blank, and visible tzitzis hang from their garments.

entries.source_note: An editorial illustration of a family lesson about honest speech. The quoted teaching warns about flattery; the scene does not establish that a particular prayer is heard. איור של לימוד משפחתי על דיבור כן. דברי המקור מזהירים מחנופה; התמונה אינה קובעת שתפילה מסוימת נשמעת.

entries.he: עַל־יְדֵי עֵסֶק הַתּוֹרָה מִתּוֹךְ דֹּחַק תְּפִלָּתוֹ נִשְׁמָעַת.
entries.en: 5. Through engaging in Torah whilst under duress, one's prayer is heard.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 5
images.description: A bearded Na Nach father teaches two smiling boys beside a modest vegetable garden, under a visibly torn and patched shade cloth. Patched clothes, a worn closed book and a sparse shared snack retain the material hardship while the family finds joy in learning.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 5
images.description: A bearded Na Nach father teaches two smiling boys beside a modest vegetable garden, under a visibly torn and patched shade cloth. Patched clothes, a worn closed book and a sparse shared snack retain the material hardship while the family finds joy in learning.

entries.source_note: An editorial illustration of Torah learning amid material hardship. The picture does not depict or prove an answer to prayer. איור של לימוד תורה מתוך דוחק חומרי. התמונה אינה מציגה או מוכיחה מענה לתפילה.

entries.he: הַמִּתְפַּלֵּל עַל חֲבֵרוֹ, וְהוּא צָרִיךְ לְאוֹתוֹ דָּבָר, הוּא נַעֲנֶה תְּחִלָּה.
entries.en: 6. One who prays for his friend, and he [himself] needs the thing [he is praying for], he is answered first.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 6
images.description: Two bearded Na Nach fathers and their boys stand beside equally dry vegetable plots. One father prays while the neighboring family shares the same need for rain; the children remain warmly close. No rain or recovery is shown.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 6
images.description: Two bearded Na Nach fathers and their boys stand beside equally dry vegetable plots. One father prays while the neighboring family shares the same need for rain; the children remain warmly close. No rain or recovery is shown.

entries.source_note: An editorial scene of praying for a friend while sharing the same need. The quoted teaching, not a depicted sequence of events, states who is answered first. איור של תפילה על חבר מתוך צורך משותף. דברי המקור, ולא רצף אירועים בתמונה, קובעים מי נענה תחילה.

entries.he: מִי שֶׁדַּעְתּוֹ שְׁפֵלָה עָלָיו, אֵין תְּפִלָּתוֹ נִמְאֶסֶת.
entries.en: 7. One who has a humble opinion of himself, his prayer is not despised.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 7
images.description: A bearded Na Nach father sits at eye level with four smiling boys in a leafy garden. His quiet humble prayer and the children's affectionate attention convey dignity and warmth rather than self-abasement; a plain closed book rests on the table.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 7
images.description: A bearded Na Nach father sits at eye level with four smiling boys in a leafy garden. His quiet humble prayer and the children's affectionate attention convey dignity and warmth rather than self-abasement; a plain closed book rests on the table.

entries.source_note: An editorial illustration of dignified humility and prayer, not self-hatred or humiliation. איור של ענווה ותפילה מתוך כבוד, ולא של שנאה עצמית או השפלה.

entries.en: 8. A person should always preempt prayer before trouble.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 8
images.description: Two bearded Na Nach fathers and their boys pause together on a broad coastal path in calm bright weather. Some pray while a boy speaks warmly with his father; distant clouds remain offshore and nobody is in danger.

images.source: AI-generated with ChatGPT/OpenAI; caption from Sefer HaMidos, Prayer, Part 1, teaching 8
images.description: Two bearded Na Nach fathers and their boys pause together on a broad coastal path in calm bright weather. Some pray while a boy speaks warmly with his father; distant clouds remain offshore and nobody is in danger.

entries.source_note: An editorial illustration of prayer before trouble, not a promise that trouble will never come. איור של הקדמת תפילה לצרה, ולא הבטחה שצרה לעולם לא תבוא.
